title: GOOD: MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES prevents memory exhaustion DoS
description:
Location: rust/lichen-rpl/src/dodag.rs lines 30, 390-393

The parent candidate set is bounded by MAX_PARENT_CANDIDATES (16). New candidates beyond this limit are silently rejected (line 390-393). This prevents an attacker from exhausting memory by sending many unique neighbor addresses.

The limit is tested in parent_candidates_fail_closed_at_neighbor_limit (line 1056).
